name: Why should a plastic surgeon prioritize AEO over other digital marketing strategies?

mainEntity.name: Why should a plastic surgeon prioritize AEO over other digital marketing strategies?

acceptedAnswer.text: A plastic surgeon should prioritize AEO because patient search behaviors are rapidly evolving towards AI-driven queries and voice search. By optimizing for AEO, your practice positions itself at the forefront of this shift, ensuring visibility in the channels where future patients are increasingly looking for information. While other strategies remain important, AEO provides a critical advantage in capturing attention from patients using smart devices and conversational AI, leading to more qualified leads who are actively seeking your services.
acceptedAnswer.description: A plastic surgeon should prioritize AEO to capture patients using AI-driven search and voice, staying ahead of evolving search behaviors.
